rule.quote: Any bugfix PR must be accompanied by a screenshot of the error (either terminal or within the tool), and the script/tool running without error afterward.

rule.quote: When opening a pull request, please follow the pull request template. It asks for a concise explanation, one real example, and direct before/after evidence before any additional detail.

evidence.what: Two or more template headings absent
evidence.output: Missing headings: ['In one sentence', 'One real example', 'Before', 'After this PR', 'Proof', 'Why / where this is useful']

findings.suggested_fix: Do not delete the PR template headings; fill in each section rather than replacing the template structure.

rule.quote: **In one sentence:** <!-- Explain what someone can do with this; don't list features. -->

evidence.what: Section heading "In one sentence" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Fill in "In one sentence" with a single sentence describing what a user can do with this PR — not a list of features.

rule.quote: **One real example:** Starting with [real data/input], I [action], and it produced [result].

evidence.what: Section heading "One real example" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Complete "One real example" with your actual data, command, and result — replace every placeholder in brackets with real specifics.

rule.quote: **Before:** <!-- What happened without this PR? -->

evidence.what: Section heading "Before" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Fill in the "Before" section describing what happened without this PR.

rule.quote: **After this PR:** <!-- What happens now? -->

evidence.what: Section heading "After this PR" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Fill in "After this PR" describing the new behaviour.

rule.quote: **Proof:** <!-- Attach the image, video, output, or benchmark. Use the same input/settings for comparisons and say what we should look at. -->

evidence.what: Section heading "Proof" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Attach real proof in the "Proof" section — an image, video, terminal output block, or benchmark table; a verbal description alone is not sufficient.

rule.quote: Use the same input/settings for comparisons and say what we should look at.

evidence.what: Proof does not clearly say what the reviewer should look at

findings.suggested_fix: Your proof must use the same input and settings as your example, and must say what the reviewer should look at.

rule.quote: **Why / where this is useful:** <!-- Who would use this result, and what can they do next? -->

evidence.what: Section heading "Why / where this is useful" is absent from PR body.
evidence.output: Heading not found anywhere in body.

findings.suggested_fix: Fill in "Why / where this is useful" naming who benefits and what they can do next.

rule.quote: - [ ] I personally verified that the example and proof above were produced by this PR on the stated data.

evidence.what: Checkbox state in raw Markdown
Machine limitation
evidence.output: A ticked checkbox does not prove the contributor ran the code. A human reviewer must confirm: (1) does the Before section describe something this diff would actually change? (2) does the After section describe a result that this diff would actually produce? (3) do the screenshots/output blocks match the diff's changes?

findings.suggested_fix: Human reviewer: confirm the contributor personally ran this PR's code on the stated data and that the Before/After sections plausibly come from this diff.
